families.name: GENERATED_COMPILATION_FAILURES
families.coverage: Three mapped and three unmapped generated C# compilation failures preserved target-native diagnostic codes, generated-source domain and safe location behavior; mapped offsets were allowed beyond the SQL document length and unmapped cases remained unknown rather than being clamped or relabeled as SQL.

families.name: INCOMPATIBLE_CACHED_ARTIFACTS
families.coverage: Artifact format, engine, compilation-options, Runtime V2 contract, execution-semantics and strict generated-code-hash incompatibilities all returned MQ8002 runtime artifact diagnostics with explicit recompile guidance and no unsupported-SQL classification.

families.name: INTERNAL_FAILURE_SAFETY
families.coverage: Unexpected compiler exception shapes returned MQ9001 internal diagnostics with correlation identifiers and safe exception facts; native messages, paths and nested details remained absent from default text and JSON while known safe spans were preserved.

families.name: EARLY_KNOWN_INVALID_QUERIES
families.coverage: One parse-invalid and five bind-invalid queries stopped at MQ2005 or MQ3001 before generated recovery, artifact incompatibility or internal-failure diagnostics could be emitted.

contract.verificationResult: 24/24 frozen cases verified before and after the authoritative replay; no frozen expectation was replaced.

initialObservations.finding: The first focused fixture compilation stopped on test-harness namespace/import and nullable source-name issues; no test result artifact or behavioral observation was published.
The frozen 24-case generated-artifact recovery matrix passed in all four focused test methods after fixture calibration.

observations.generated: GEN-MAPPED-01..03 and GEN-UNMAPPED-01..03 all preserved MQ8001 CodeGeneration diagnostics and target-native facts; mapped generated offsets were not interpreted against or clamped to SQL source length, while unmapped locations remained unknown.
observations.artifacts: ART-01..06 all preserved MQ8002 Runtime artifact incompatibility with GeneratedSource domain, unknown location and catalog recompile guidance.
observations.internal: INT-01..06 all preserved MQ9001 Internal diagnostics with correlation identifiers; default text and JSON did not expose native exception messages, source paths or nested stack details.

repairAttempts.description: Corrected missing parser/compiler test-harness imports and nullable generated-source path handling after the initial fixture compilation attempts; no production code changed.

harnessBoundary: All cases are local, finite and explicitly declared in the frozen contract; injected generated diagnostics and artifact mutations are controlled fixture workloads.
The generated-source location assertions intentionally use offsets beyond SQL length to prove that generated coordinates are not clamped to the original query.
The artifact matrix validates current loader contracts and recompile guidance; it does not claim compatibility with arbitrary external artifact producers.
The result is engine-owned converter/parser diagnostic evidence only and makes no installed CLI, host/product, human workflow, AI-agent or universal conformance claim.
